GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-03-27T13:12:38Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs '1.2.840.113549.1.1.5' is not a known hash algorithm.
Description: i'm trying to compute a cms SHA1RSA using the pre release version(4.5.0-preview1-26216-02) of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs.

Oid.FromFriendlyName("SHA1RSA",OidGroup.SignatureAlgorithm) returns the corect digest algorithem, but upon calling encode, i get the exception that i,m not using any known hash algorithm.

Is there any short term plan to incorporate it?

Encoding snippet:----------
protected byte[] GenerateSignature(byte[] fileContent)
        {
            CmsSigner signer = new CmsSigner(SubjectIdentifierType.IssuerAndSerialNumber, ClientCert);
            SignedCms signedCms = new SignedCms(new ContentInfo(fileContent), false);
            signer = new CmsSigner(SubjectIdentifierType.IssuerAndSerialNumber, ClientCert);
            signer.DigestAlgorithm = Oid.FromFriendlyName("SHA1RSA",OidGroup.SignatureAlgorithm);
            signedCms.ComputeSignature(signer, false);
            var signature = signedCms.Encode();
            return signature;
        }

llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a specific error when using the System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs library to compute a CMS SHA1RSA signature. The problem is that the code is setting the DigestAlgorithm to "SHA1RSA" which is causing an error because "1.2.840.113549.1.1.5" (the OID for SHA1RSA) is not recognized as a hash algorithm. This is a conceptual misunderstanding - SHA1RSA is a signature algorithm that combines SHA1 (hash) with RSA (encryption), not a pure hash algorithm. The solution would involve using the correct hash algorithm (like "SHA1") instead. This can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. The issue is about proper API usage and understanding cryptographic concepts rather than something that requires actual execution to verify.
